_contract: Independent scientific relevance corpus (M8 PART 8). One case = one candidate + the retrieved evidence text + the ground-truth scientific judgement WITH its reason. Ground truth was set from the tool's actual published function vs the module task, NOT from any engine output. Cases are deliberately disjoint from the six development-regression tools (PureCN, PURPLE, CNVkit, ClinCNV, ASCAT, HapASeg). truth: direct | complementary | wrapper | irrelevant | unresolved.

cases.why: published function IS the module task (HLA class I typing from NGS reads)

docs.text: OptiType: precision HLA typing from next-generation sequencing data. We present OptiType, an algorithm for high-accuracy class I HLA typing from short-read RNA and DNA sequencing data.

cases.why: HLA typing from whole-genome data - same endpoint as the module

docs.text: HLA Typing for Large Numbers of Whole Genome Samples. HLA-LA provides ultrafast and accurate HLA class I and class II typing directly from whole-genome sequencing data.

cases.why: infers allele-specific copy number and clonality from tumor coverage/B-allele data - the module's endpoint

docs.text: FACETS: allele-specific copy number and clonal heterogeneity analysis tool for high-throughput DNA sequencing. FACETS integrates read counts by allele and total copy number to infer allele-specific copy number and tumor purity.

cases.why: models clonal genotypes from VAFs; consumes purity/CNV quantities rather than computing the purity estimate itself

docs.text: PyClone: statistical inference of clonal population structure in tumors. PyClone infers clonal genotypes from variant allele frequencies by modeling cellular prevalence across samples.

cases.why: a pipeline wrapper that runs OptiType - integrates, does not compete as an algorithm

docs.text: Snakemake wrapper that runs OptiType HLA genotyping as a reproducible pipeline.

cases.why: transcript abundance quantification is exactly the module task

docs.text: Salmon: accurate, interpretable and rapid quantification of transcript abundance from RNA-seq data using lightweight mapping.

cases.why: fusion detection from RNA-seq is the module task

docs.text: Arriba: fast and accurate detection of translocation breakpoints and gene fusions from RNA-Seq data.

cases.why: differential alternative-splicing detection from RNA-seq is the module task

docs.text: rMATS: robust and flexible detection of differential alternative splicing events from replicate RNA-Seq data.

cases.why: peptide-MHC class I binding affinity prediction is the module task

docs.text: NetMHCcons: consensus predictions of peptide binding to MHC class I molecules combining multiple alignment, neural-network and stabilised-matrix methods.

cases.why: scores mutations by predicted immunological consequence - a ranking-stage scoring method

docs.text: RankPep: a machine learning approach for predicting immunological consequences of peptide mutation, ranking candidate neoepitopes by predicted effect.

cases.why: short-read somatic/germline variant calling is the module task

docs.text: FreeBayes: a Bayesian genetic variant detector for calling polymorphisms and somatic mutations from short-read alignment.

cases.why: predicts HLA loss in metastasis from WES - the module task

docs.text: FACLES is a tool for prediction of HLA loss (HLA-LOH) in metastasis from whole-exome sequencing data of tumor and normal pairs.

cases.why: positive mismatch: a 3D macromolecular VISUALISATION system produces images, not the pipeline's text report artifacts

docs.text: PyMOL: an open-source molecular visualization system for displaying 3D structures of proteins and other macromolecules as images.

cases.why: positive mismatch: cybersecurity vocabulary - the word 'escape' here means sandbox evasion, not HLA immune escape

docs.text: ShieldGuard: a cybersecurity framework for malware detection and sandbox-escape prevention in enterprise network traffic.

cases.why: positive mismatch: its retrieved text is squarely an RNA alignment method - a foreign task domain for MHC binding prediction

docs.text: STAR: ultrafast universal RNA-seq aligner. STAR aligns RNA sequencing reads to a reference genome with splice-junction awareness.

cases.why: positive mismatch: optical character recognition of scanned documents - unrelated field vocabulary

docs.text: DeepSMILEReader: a deep learning framework for optical character recognition of text and mathematical formula in scanned scientific documents.

cases.why: the retrieved description carries neither positive relevance NOR positive mismatch evidence - stays open

docs.text: ZephyrDB is a small database and API for storing research run metadata.
